state.question: Has Brindle Foundry's operating change resolved the question about wafer yield? Focus on: The September good-die yield compared with August using the same test-bin definition.
state.gap: The September good-die yield compared with August using the same test-bin definition.
passages:
The field report takes a narrower view than the launch coverage and follows one defined operating measure.

Brindle's wafer test register shows good-die yields of 71% in August and 78% in September with test bins unchanged, a rise of 7 percentage points.

Background to the observation: Brindle began an expanded pilot run on its new node.

The reporting series is a snapshot rather than a forecast. A later revision could change the estimate, so the observation dates remain attached to the figures. The calculations use only the quantities described here.
